messages:
Maria H.: Heads-up on the console tour tooltip — it immediately covers the top-right deploy CTA after signup. Feels disruptive. Can we soften timing and update copy?
Jon W.: Yup spotted this in usability tests. Users click through too fast. Proposal: delay first show 8s and shorten copy. :hourglass: 
Aisha R.: For brevity I'd suggest: `See the console walkthrough` for header line and blurb `Quick tour of deployments, runs, and observability.`
Lee Z.: Also prefer buttons: primary `Start walkthrough`, secondary `Remind me later`. 'Skip' feels abrupt.
Maria H.: Good. Also let's avoid microcopy that implies permanence like 'Don't show again'. Keep it reversible.
Jon W.: Accessibility note: tooltip should be programmatically linked with `aria-describedby` and announced as `role="dialog"`. Need keyboard focus return on dismiss. I'll add to the a11y checklist.
Aisha R.: Small tone nit: `Quick tour` vs `Walkthrough` — I lean `walkthrough` for clarity.
Lee Z.: I'll make two mocks in Figma: Variant A = terse copy + 8s delay; Variant B = slightly explanatory + 3s delay. We'll A/B those.
ProductBot: Linked PR checklist: https://redwood.internal/boards/onboarding-tooltips (added by @Jon W.)
Maria H.: Can we lock on final strings today? PM wants to schedule eng pick-up Monday.
Jon W.: I'll paste exact token strings into the doc after final review.
Aisha R.: Opening an a11y ticket for focus management and ESC behavior to avoid focus traps.
Lee Z.: Also adding a note about motion preferences — respect reduced-motion.
Maria H.: Final call: primary `Start walkthrough`, secondary `Remind me later`, blurb `A short walkthrough of the console: deployments, runs, and observability.`, initial delay 8s. Unless objections?
Jon W.: No objections.
Aisha R.: Sounds good to me.
Lee Z.: I'll attach the mocks and animation specs.
Maria H.: Thanks all — I'll update the onboarding doc and hand off to eng. :rocket:
